title: Spanish Courgette Stir Fry
description: A light and flavorful vegetarian dish from Spain, featuring courgette, crispy fried elements, and a hint of Spanish flair.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the crushed fried crispy and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the courgette and cook for 5 minutes, until tender.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper over the courgette and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the courgette mixture hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
